dialogues.jp:
とりあえずお茶で一服してから、俺は頼子さん
に切り出した。
dialogues.en: (But who is it anyway......?)
dialogues.text: (But who is it anyway......?)

dialogues.jp: 「で、頼子さん、部屋の事なんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
Visitors to my house have never been any good. They're
either newspaper salesmen or someone who wants to pray for
my happiness.
dialogues.text:
Visitors to my house have never been any good. They're
either newspaper salesmen or someone who wants to pray for
my happiness.

dialogues.jp: 二人して玄関の方に目を遣る。
dialogues.en: What a pain... But I walk to the front door.
dialogues.text: What a pain... But I walk to the front door.

dialogues.jp:
腰を浮かせた頼子さんを手で止める。メイドだ
からと言って、急に人をあごで使う気にはなれ
ない。
dialogues.en: "I knew whoever you are couldn't be any good."
dialogues.text: "I knew whoever you are couldn't be any good."

dialogues.jp: （しかし、誰だ……？）
dialogues.en: "Are you sure? I thought you liked beef bowl."
dialogues.text: "Are you sure? I thought you liked beef bowl."

dialogues.jp:
俺の家の来訪者なんて、ろくなのがない。新聞
の勧誘だとか、あなたの幸せを拝ませてくれだ
とか。
dialogues.en:
He opens the bag, and I can smell the significant smell of
my favorite food, beef bowl.
dialogues.text:
He opens the bag, and I can smell the significant smell of
my favorite food, beef bowl.

dialogues.jp: かったるいなあと思いつつ、玄関に向かう。
dialogues.en: "When did you start selling beef bowls?"
dialogues.text: "When did you start selling beef bowls?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？　お前、牛丼好きだっただろ？」
dialogues.en:
"Ha-ha-ha! Don't worry. It's on me. I'm not gonna sell it to
you."
dialogues.text:
"Ha-ha-ha! Don't worry. It's on me. I'm not gonna sell it to
you."

dialogues.jp:
しれっと言いつつ、牛丼屋の袋を掲げる。あの
独特の匂いが鼻先に漂ってくる。
dialogues.en: "I'm not buying it."
dialogues.text: "I'm not buying it."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「はっはっは。心配するな、俺のおごりだ。売
　りつけようとは思わん」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I wonder if Sagie likes beef bowl......"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I wonder if Sagie likes beef bowl......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「誰が買うか」
dialogues.en: "Who?"
dialogues.text: "Who?"

dialogues.jp:
するりと横をすり抜け、ドアに向かう背中に呼
びかける。頭が痛い。
dialogues.en:
I ask him who he's talking about, and then he quickly walks
in past my side. I chase him. Oh man, he's a headache.
dialogues.text:
I ask him who he's talking about, and then he quickly walks
in past my side. I chase him. Oh man, he's a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「決まってるじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "You know who I'm talking about."
dialogues.text: "You know who I'm talking about."

dialogues.jp: くるりと振り返って、にかりと笑う。
dialogues.en: He turns around and smiles at me.
dialogues.text: He turns around and smiles at me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前の家へと｛どうざ／動座｝された、初音島の神秘だよ」
dialogues.en:
"The mysterious girl of Hatsune Island, who's going to live
with you."
dialogues.text:
"The mysterious girl of Hatsune Island, who's going to live
with you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「こ、これは……」
dialogues.en: "What's this......?"
dialogues.text: "What's this......?"

dialogues.jp:
テーブルの上に並べられた牛丼から、もわりと
湯気が立ち上る。
dialogues.en: Steam's rising from the beef bowls on the table.
dialogues.text: Steam's rising from the beef bowls on the table.

dialogues.jp: その湯気の向こうで、頼子さんが固まっていた。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko doesn't seem to move as the steam rises from the
food.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko doesn't seem to move as the steam rises from the
food.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ぬあ。その反応は。もしや、サギーは牛丼が
　お嫌いでしたか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh no, Sagie, you don't like beef bowl, do you?"
dialogues.text: "Oh no, Sagie, you don't like beef bowl, do you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「だから、妙な愛称は止めろよ。容赦なく、誰
　の事だか分かってないぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Please stop calling her Sagie. She doesn't know who you are
talking about."
dialogues.text:
"Please stop calling her Sagie. She doesn't know who you are
talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「むう。俺なりのスキンシップのつもりだった
　のだが」
dialogues.en: "Humm. It was my way to have personal contact with her."
dialogues.text: "Humm. It was my way to have personal contact with her."

dialogues.jp: どこがだ。
dialogues.en: Yeah, right.
dialogues.text: Yeah, right.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、頼子さんはほんとに牛丼が嫌いなのだ
ろうか？　固まったまま、溶けやしない。
dialogues.en:
But does she really not like beef bowl? She still hasn't
moved a bit.
dialogues.text:
But does she really not like beef bowl? She still hasn't
moved a bit.

dialogues.jp: 「あーと、頼子さん、牛丼とか苦手だった？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Yoriko, you don't like beef bowl?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Yoriko, you don't like beef bowl?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、い、いえ。そんな事は……」
dialogues.en: "What? Ah, n-no. It's not that......"
dialogues.text: "What? Ah, n-no. It's not that......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふむ。それは良かった。それでは、いただき
　ましょうか」
dialogues.en: "Well, that's good. Then let's dig in!"
dialogues.text: "Well, that's good. Then let's dig in!"

dialogues.jp:
ご丁寧に両手を合わせる。俺と頼子さんも、何
となくそれにならう。
dialogues.en:
Suginami bows with his hands together. Yoriko-san and I sort
of follow him.
dialogues.text:
Suginami bows with his hands together. Yoriko-san and I sort
of follow him.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だが、しかしっ！」
dialogues.en: "But wait!"
dialogues.text: "But wait!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うおっ、飛ばすなよきたねえな」
dialogues.en: "Hey, stop spitting everywhere."
dialogues.text: "Hey, stop spitting everywhere."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……んぐ、ごくん。だが、しかし、俺の目的
　は、朝倉家で牛丼を喰らう事ではないっ！」
dialogues.en:
"......(He swallows.) But wait! My goal isn't to eat beef
bowl at Asakura's house!"
dialogues.text:
"......(He swallows.) But wait! My goal isn't to eat beef
bowl at Asakura's house!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「当たり前すぎるぞ」
dialogues.en: "That's too easy to guess."
dialogues.text: "That's too easy to guess."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「で、｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝さん。いくつか質問させてもらいた
　いのですが」
dialogues.en: "Sagisawa-san. May I ask you some questions?"
dialogues.text: "Sagisawa-san. May I ask you some questions?"

dialogues.jp:
珍しくというか、ミステリーに対してはそうな
のかもしれないが、真剣な目を向けた。
dialogues.en:
I know mysterious things make him get like this, but I've
never seen him so serious.
dialogues.text:
I know mysterious things make him get like this, but I've
never seen him so serious.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え……？　ん、あ、は、はい」
dialogues.en: "What......? Ah, y-yes."
dialogues.text: "What......? Ah, y-yes."

dialogues.jp:
ちんまりと箸を口に運んでいた頼子さんが、目
を白黒させて箸を置く。
dialogues.en:
She's eating gyudon little by little, but she stops her
hands, looking surprised.
dialogues.text:
She's eating gyudon little by little, but she stops her
hands, looking surprised.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……何でしょう？」
dialogues.en: "......What are your questions?"
dialogues.text: "......What are your questions?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ずばり言って、それは何です？」
dialogues.en: "I'm gonna be straight. What are those things?"
dialogues.text: "I'm gonna be straight. What are those things?"

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんは頭のネコ耳に手を遣った。
dialogues.en: Yoriko puts her hands to her cat ears on her head.
dialogues.text: Yoriko puts her hands to her cat ears on her head.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そう、それです。……それ、本当に頭から生
　えてるんじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Yes, those. ......Are they growing from your head?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, those. ......Are they growing from your head?"

dialogues.jp:
そう。あの感触は、確かに飾りなんかではあり
えなかった。
dialogues.en:
Yes. I touched them and could tell easily that they were
definitely not accessories.
dialogues.text:
Yes. I touched them and could tell easily that they were
definitely not accessories.

dialogues.jp: 「ん？　……というかお前、手で触ったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Um? ......Have you touched them?"
dialogues.text: "Um? ......Have you touched them?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。失礼してな。桜並木で初めて出会った
　時に」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. On the cherry blossom road, she let me touch them."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. On the cherry blossom road, she let me touch them."

dialogues.jp: むう。何となく腹立つな。
dialogues.en: I don't know why but I'm annoyed.
dialogues.text: I don't know why but I'm annoyed.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、これは、その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, ah, these are......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, ah, these are......"

dialogues.jp:
氷が溶けるように、見る見る小さくなっていく
頼子さん。
dialogues.en:
Just like an ice cube melting away, she's getting smaller
and smaller.
dialogues.text:
Just like an ice cube melting away, she's getting smaller
and smaller.

dialogues.jp:
手で耳を隠すようにして、こっくりと俯いてし
まった。
dialogues.en: She hides her ears with her hands and puts her head down.
dialogues.text: She hides her ears with her hands and puts her head down.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「これは……たぶん……」
dialogues.en: "These are...... probably......"
dialogues.text: "These are...... probably......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「たぶん？」
dialogues.en: "Probably?"
dialogues.text: "Probably?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、い、いえ……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I-I mean......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I-I mean......"

dialogues.jp:
失言したとでもいう感じで、口元を押さえる。
すると、いましめを失ったネコ耳がぴょこりと
立ち上がった。
dialogues.en:
She quickly covers her mouth with her hands as if she said
something wrong. As soon as she takes her hands off of her
head, her cat ears are released and stand up straight on her
head.
dialogues.text:
She quickly covers her mouth with her hands as if she said
something wrong. As soon as she takes her hands off of her
head, her cat ears are released and stand up straight on her
head.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ご、ごめんなさい……。あの、私にも……分
　からなくて……」
dialogues.en:
"I-I'm sorry...... I don't know... what they are
either......"
dialogues.text:
"I-I'm sorry...... I don't know... what they are
either......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「分からない……ですか」
dialogues.en: "You don't know......"
dialogues.text: "You don't know......"

dialogues.jp:
いかにも落胆した様子で、椅子の背に背中を預
けた。
dialogues.en: He leans against the back of his chair in disappointment.
dialogues.text: He leans against the back of his chair in disappointment.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、でも、そんなもんじゃないのか？　例
　えばだ……」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's pretty normal, right? For example......"
dialogues.text: "Well, it's pretty normal, right? For example......"

dialogues.jp: お茶をごくりと飲み、先を進める。
dialogues.en: I take a sip of my tea and continue.
dialogues.text: I take a sip of my tea and continue.

dialogues.jp:
「人間が、どうしてこういう顔の造りをしてい
　るのか、当の人間にだって分からないだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"No one knows the answers to why human faces are the way
they are, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"No one knows the answers to why human faces are the way
they are, you know?"

dialogues.jp:
「何で目はふたつなのか？　何で鼻は顔の真ん
　中にあるのか？　何で眉毛なんてのがあるの
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Why do we have two eyes? Why do we have a nose in the
center? Why do we have eyebrows?"
dialogues.text:
"Why do we have two eyes? Why do we have a nose in the
center? Why do we have eyebrows?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ……要するに進化の果てって奴だろ？　
　……うむ」
dialogues.en:
"They are how they are as a result of evolution, I guess...
Hmm."
dialogues.text:
"They are how they are as a result of evolution, I guess...
Hmm."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が自分の言葉に自分で頷く。
dialogues.en: Suginami nods at his own answer.
dialogues.text: Suginami nods at his own answer.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なるほど。そのネコ耳も実は進化の故だった
　のか」
dialogues.en: "So, the cat ears can be a part of evolution."
dialogues.text: "So, the cat ears can be a part of evolution."

dialogues.jp:
うむうむと頷く。……と、その納得が｛かし／傾｝いだ。
杉並はかくりと首を傾けたまま、
dialogues.en:
He nods deeply again. ...But then his conviction's broken.
He cocks his head in a question.
dialogues.text:
He nods deeply again. ...But then his conviction's broken.
He cocks his head in a question.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……しかし、そのネコ耳が何の役に立つ？」
dialogues.en: "......But what kind of function do those cat ears perform?"
dialogues.text: "......But what kind of function do those cat ears perform?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……可愛い」
dialogues.en: "......They're cute."
dialogues.text: "......They're cute."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
無意識のうちに漏れた言葉だった。だが、二人
には、ばっちりと聞かれてしまったらしい。
dialogues.en: I said it without thinking, but they heard it clearly.
dialogues.text: I said it without thinking, but they heard it clearly.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんの顔の赤さたるや、江戸の大火もかく
やという感じだし、杉並の視線はまさに珍獣を
見るそれだ。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san's face turns as red as a fire on a dark night. On
the other hand, Suginami's staring at her as if she's a rare
monster.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san's face turns as red as a fire on a dark night. On
the other hand, Suginami's staring at her as if she's a rare
monster.

dialogues.jp: 「……はっはっは。忘れてくれたまい」
dialogues.en: "......Ha-ha-ha. Please forget what I just said."
dialogues.text: "......Ha-ha-ha. Please forget what I just said."

dialogues.jp:
まぐまぐと、牛丼をかき込む。あまり角度をつ
けると、容器で顔が隠れる前に、中身が、｛ほうらく／崩落｝
しそうだった。
dialogues.en:
I scarf down my beef bowl. I put my mouth on the edge of the
bowl and tilt it to hide my face. It almost causes an
avalanche of food towards my face.
dialogues.text:
I scarf down my beef bowl. I put my mouth on the edge of the
bowl and tilt it to hide my face. It almost causes an
avalanche of food towards my face.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……ふむ。まあ、お前の特殊な趣味について
　のカミングアウトはさておきとして」
dialogues.en: "......Hmm. Let's put aside your weird interest for now..."
dialogues.text: "......Hmm. Let's put aside your weird interest for now..."

dialogues.jp:
憎たらしい事を言いながら、杉並は頼子さんに
向き直った。彼女の頬は、未ださめやらない。
dialogues.en:
Suginami says in a provoking tone of voice, and turns around
to Yoriko-san. Her face is still red.
dialogues.text:
Suginami says in a provoking tone of voice, and turns around
to Yoriko-san. Her face is still red.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「んでは、二つ目の質問として、いったい、そ
　のメイド服は？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, my second question. Why are you wearing a maid
costume?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, my second question. Why are you wearing a maid
costume?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こ、これは……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, this is......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, this is......"

dialogues.jp: 胸元を見下ろす。
dialogues.en: She looked down on her chest.
dialogues.text: She looked down on her chest.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「えと、その……」
dialogues.en: "Umm... this is a......"
dialogues.text: "Umm... this is a......"

dialogues.jp:
何やらタメが効いている。俺も杉並も、続きは
何かと、身を乗り出した。
dialogues.en:
The way she sits in silence makes us anticipate the answer
more. Suginami and I lean forward towards her to hear what
she's going to say.
dialogues.text:
The way she sits in silence makes us anticipate the answer
more. Suginami and I lean forward towards her to hear what
she's going to say.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「えと……だから……」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だから？　何です？」
dialogues.en: "I don't know. What?"
dialogues.text: "I don't know. What?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……何となく……です」
dialogues.en: "......For no reason......"
dialogues.text: "......For no reason......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ご、ごめんなさい……」
dialogues.en: "I...I'm s-sorry......"
dialogues.text: "I...I'm s-sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
ふたりの脱力ぶりを感じ取ったのか、頼子さん
はぺこぺこ謝ったのだった。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko sees us sink down weakly in disappointment, so she
apologizes, bowing her head several times.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko sees us sink down weakly in disappointment, so she
apologizes, bowing her head several times.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふう……美味い。さては朝倉、このお茶は玉
　露入りだな？」
dialogues.en: "Hah...... It's tasty. Asakura, is this refined green tea?"
dialogues.text: "Hah...... It's tasty. Asakura, is this refined green tea?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「１００ｇ１００円の粗茶だよ」
dialogues.en: "No, I bought it at a 100-yen store."
dialogues.text: "No, I bought it at a 100-yen store."

dialogues.jp:
本当のところは知らない。音夢が買い置きして
おいたのを淹れただけだ。
dialogues.en: I'm not sure, but Nemu bought it before and I just used it.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure, but Nemu bought it before and I just used it.

dialogues.jp:
メシも終わり、俺達はまったりとお茶をすすっ
ていた。
dialogues.en: We finish dinner and sit down quietly drinking green tea.
dialogues.text: We finish dinner and sit down quietly drinking green tea.

dialogues.jp: 「というかお前、茶飲んだらさっさと帰れよな」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, you'd better go home after you finish your tea."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, you'd better go home after you finish your tea."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
びくっと、道ばたの野良猫のように素早い視線
を送ってきた。
dialogues.en:
She jumps a little, and quickly gives me a look like a
scared cat on a road.
dialogues.text:
She jumps a little, and quickly gives me a look like a
scared cat on a road.

dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、もちろん杉並の事ね」
dialogues.en: "No, I was talking to Suginami, not you, of course."
dialogues.text: "No, I was talking to Suginami, not you, of course."

dialogues.jp:
どうにも、警戒心というか反応が過剰だな。
……猫だから？
dialogues.en: She's very cautious and really jumpy...... like a cat?
dialogues.text: She's very cautious and really jumpy...... like a cat?

dialogues.jp:
杉並はずりずりと茶をすすり、茶碗を置いた。
かつんという音が、やけに大きく響く。
dialogues.en:
Suginami sips the rest of his tea loudly and puts the teacup
on the table. The sound of the glass hitting the table
echoes in the room.
dialogues.text:
Suginami sips the rest of his tea loudly and puts the teacup
on the table. The sound of the glass hitting the table
echoes in the room.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、｛き／訊｝きたい事はだいたい訊いた。確かに、
　これ以上、この何の変哲もない家で過ごす理
　由はないな」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I got almost all the answers to my questions. I guess
I have absolutely no other reason to stay in this boring
house."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I got almost all the answers to my questions. I guess
I have absolutely no other reason to stay in this boring
house."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「変哲のある家ってどんなだよ」
dialogues.en: "What kind of house is not boring to you?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of house is not boring to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「時計館とか黒猫館とか色々あるが、ま、その
　レクチャーはまた今度だな」
dialogues.en:
"There are houses like a clock house and a black cat house,
you know. Anyway, I will teach you the details about them
next time."
dialogues.text:
"There are houses like a clock house and a black cat house,
you know. Anyway, I will teach you the details about them
next time."

dialogues.jp: “今度”が永久に遠いといいのだが。
dialogues.en:
I hope his 'next time' won't come for a long time, like
forever.
dialogues.text:
I hope his 'next time' won't come for a long time, like
forever.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうそう。あと、もう一つ気になっていたこ
　とが」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I almost forgot. I have one more thing I wanted to
ask."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I almost forgot. I have one more thing I wanted to
ask."

dialogues.jp:
俺と頼子さん、等分に視線を送ってくる。頭の
ねじが外れたのか、変ににやけ顔だ。
dialogues.en:
He looks at Yoriko-san and me alternately. The serious face
he had earlier is gone, and now he has a nasty smile.
dialogues.text:
He looks at Yoriko-san and me alternately. The serious face
he had earlier is gone, and now he has a nasty smile.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「鷺澤さん、どこに寝泊まりさせるつもりだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where are you going to let her sleep?"
dialogues.text: "Where are you going to let her sleep?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まさか、お前の部屋に一緒させるつもりじゃ
　ないだろうな？　ネコ耳好きな朝倉君よ」
dialogues.en:
"You're not thinking about letting her sleep in your room
with you, are you? You can't do that even if you like cat
ears so much, right?"
dialogues.text:
"You're not thinking about letting her sleep in your room
with you, are you? You can't do that even if you like cat
ears so much, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……指をさすな」
dialogues.en: "......Don't point your finger at me."
dialogues.text: "......Don't point your finger at me."

dialogues.jp: ｛じゃけん／邪険｝に人差し指を払いのける。
dialogues.en: I move his finger away bluntly.
dialogues.text: I move his finger away bluntly.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、それについてなんだけど、さっきも言
　おうと思ったんだ」
dialogues.en: "About that, I was gonna talk to you, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "About that, I was gonna talk to you, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は視界に入れず、頼子さんに語りかける。
dialogues.en: I face Yoriko-san so that I don't have to see Suginami.
dialogues.text: I face Yoriko-san so that I don't have to see Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
「言おうと思ったところで、この馬鹿が現れたっ
　て訳なんだけど」
dialogues.en:
"I was about to talk about it, and...... this moron came to
interrupt us."
dialogues.text:
"I was about to talk about it, and...... this moron came to
interrupt us."

dialogues.jp:
「部屋、どうしようか？　空いてる部屋なんて
　ないんだよね」
dialogues.en:
"I actually don't know what to do, because I don't have an
empty room."
dialogues.text:
"I actually don't know what to do, because I don't have an
empty room."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「部屋……ですか」
dialogues.en: "No room......"
dialogues.text: "No room......"

dialogues.jp: 唇に指先をあて、天井を見上げる。
dialogues.en:
She puts her fingertip on her lips and looks up at the
ceiling.
dialogues.text:
She puts her fingertip on her lips and looks up at the
ceiling.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、狭い家ではないと思うが、客人用の部屋
があるような豪邸でもない。
dialogues.en:
I don't think my house is that small, but it's not a mansion
that has guest rooms either.
dialogues.text:
I don't think my house is that small, but it's not a mansion
that has guest rooms either.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉妹の部屋が空いてるだろう？　さっきの
　桜並木でも、俺はそれを念頭に置いていたが」
dialogues.en:
"Your sister's room's available. When we were talking on the
cherry blossom road, I was talking about that room."
dialogues.text:
"Your sister's room's available. When we were talking on the
cherry blossom road, I was talking about that room."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「音夢の部屋？　馬鹿言うなって。張っ倒され
　るわ」
dialogues.en: "Nemu's room? No way. She'd kill me."
dialogues.text: "Nemu's room? No way. She'd kill me."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふん？　そんな女にも見えないがな」
dialogues.en: "Really? She doesn't look like that kind of girl to me."
dialogues.text: "Really? She doesn't look like that kind of girl to me."

dialogues.jp:
なるほど、杉並は裏モードの音夢しか知らない
んだっけ。だったら、意外に思うかも。
dialogues.en:
Oh, I see. He doesn't know how she is at home. He'll be so
surprised to find out what kind of girl she really is.
dialogues.text:
Oh, I see. He doesn't know how she is at home. He'll be so
surprised to find out what kind of girl she really is.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah, excuse me......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, excuse me......"

dialogues.speaker: Junichi & Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うん？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いえ、杉並さんではなくて……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, not you, Suginami-san......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, not you, Suginami-san......"

dialogues.jp: 何となく勝ち誇った気分になりつつ、先を促す。
dialogues.en: I feel like I won a game, and encourage her to continue.
dialogues.text: I feel like I won a game, and encourage her to continue.

dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、その……音夢さん、という方は……？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, who is...... Nemu-san......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, who is...... Nemu-san......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、俺の妹。今はちょいと家を出ていてね。
　看護師になるだとか何だとかで」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, she's my little sister. She doesn't live here now. She
wants to be a nurse and she moved out."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, she's my little sister. She doesn't live here now. She
wants to be a nurse and she moved out."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「妹さん……ですか」
dialogues.en: "Your little sister......"
dialogues.text: "Your little sister......"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「こいつはえらいシスコンでしてねえ。今でも
　夜は枕を濡らしてるんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"He is so close to his sister, and he still cries every
night because he misses her so much."
dialogues.text:
"He is so close to his sister, and he still cries every
night because he misses her so much."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、ほんとに。だから、｛さぎさわ／鷺澤｝さん、良かっ
　たらこいつを慰めてやってもらえますか」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, really. So if you don't mind, can you please comfort
his sorrow?"
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, really. So if you don't mind, can you please comfort
his sorrow?"

dialogues.jp:
えぐえぐと泣き真似をしながらしょうもない事
を言う。
dialogues.en: He's pretending to cry for me.
dialogues.text: He's pretending to cry for me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの……音夢さんて方は、その……」
dialogues.en: "Ah...... does she...... ummm..."
dialogues.text: "Ah...... does she...... ummm..."

dialogues.jp:
こっくりとうつむき、テーブルの上に組み合わ
せた手を見つめながら、頼子さんは言った。
dialogues.en:
She looks down at her hands clasped together on the table
and says,
dialogues.text:
She looks down at her hands clasped together on the table
and says,

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「黄色いリボンを……してらっしゃいますか？」
dialogues.en: "Does she wear a yellow ribbon?"
dialogues.text: "Does she wear a yellow ribbon?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、してるけど？」
dialogues.en: "Yes, she does."
dialogues.text: "Yes, she does."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, okay."
dialogues.text: "Oh, okay."

dialogues.jp: さすがに気が付いた。

頼子さんは確かに今、｛・・・・・／ホッとした｝。安心の吐息
をもらしたのだ。
dialogues.en:
It's easy to notice. She's happy. I can tell she's relieved
to hear it.
dialogues.text:
It's easy to notice. She's happy. I can tell she's relieved
to hear it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　朝倉妹が黄色いリボンを外すと、何か
　問題でも？　封印が解けるとか……？」
dialogues.en:
"Is there any problem if his sister takes off her yellow
ribbon? Does the yellow ribbon do something to you, like it
can break the spell on you or something?"
dialogues.text:
"Is there any problem if his sister takes off her yellow
ribbon? Does the yellow ribbon do something to you, like it
can break the spell on you or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「い、いえ、その……ちょっと気になっただけ
　で……」
dialogues.en: "N-No. I was just... curious......"
dialogues.text: "N-No. I was just... curious......"

dialogues.jp:
おどおどと弁解らしき呟きをもらすが、当の杉
並は旅立っていて聞いちゃいない。
dialogues.en:
She's sheepishly trying to make excuses, but Suginami, who
asked her the question, is already moving on to his next
interest and isn't listening to her at all.
dialogues.text:
She's sheepishly trying to make excuses, but Suginami, who
asked her the question, is already moving on to his next
interest and isn't listening to her at all.

dialogues.jp: （黄色いリボン……）
dialogues.en: (A yellow ribbon......)
dialogues.text: (A yellow ribbon......)

dialogues.jp: そして俺はと言えば、あの夢を思い出していた。
dialogues.en: And I'm thinking about the dream I had.
dialogues.text: And I'm thinking about the dream I had.

dialogues.jp:
黄色いリボン。──黄色い鈴でも、はたまた黄
色いモンキーでもなくて。
dialogues.en:
A yellow ribbon. -- It's not a yellow bell or a yellow
monkey but a yellow ribbon.
dialogues.text:
A yellow ribbon. -- It's not a yellow bell or a yellow
monkey but a yellow ribbon.

dialogues.jp: 俺は頼子さんのネコ耳に目を遣った。
dialogues.en: I look at Yoriko-san's cat ears.
dialogues.text: I look at Yoriko-san's cat ears.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんの――
dialogues.en: 'Yoriko.'
dialogues.text: 'Yoriko.'

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「な、なあっ、朝倉！　頼む、教えてくれ！　
　朝倉妹の正体は何なんだ！？　悪魔か？　
　超獣か？　二重｛らせん／螺旋｝の悪魔なのかぁ！？」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura, please! Please tell me about your sister! Who is
she really? A devil? A monster? A helical evil!?"
dialogues.text:
"Asakura, please! Please tell me about your sister! Who is
she really? A devil? A monster? A helical evil!?"

dialogues.jp:
もうちょっと可愛いのは出てこないのかよ。天
女とかさ……。
dialogues.en:
Can't he come up with anything cuter? Something like an
angel?
dialogues.text:
Can't he come up with anything cuter? Something like an
angel?

dialogues.jp:
結局頼子さんは、居間で寝起きするという事に
決まったのだった。
dialogues.en:
After all that, we decided that Yoriko-san should sleep in
the living room.
dialogues.text:
After all that, we decided that Yoriko-san should sleep in
the living room.

dialogues.jp: ◆杉並の来訪◆
dialogues.en: ◆After a cup of tea, I ask Yoriko.◆
dialogues.text: ◆After a cup of tea, I ask Yoriko.◆

dialogues.jp:
家に帰って、一服した頃、杉並がいきなりやっ
てきた。
dialogues.en: "So, Yoriko-san, about your room......"
dialogues.text: "So, Yoriko-san, about your room......"

dialogues.jp:
杉並が持参した牛丼を三人で食べつつ、頼子さ
んに色々尋ねるが、ネコ耳のことなどは本人も
よくわからないらしい。

そのうちに、部屋はどこを使ってもらうのかと
いう話になったが、家を出たとはいえ音夢の部
屋というわけにはいかないだろう……。
dialogues.en: We both looked at the front door.
dialogues.text: We both looked at the front door.

dialogues.jp:
音夢は黄色いリボンをしているか、と頼子さん
に尋ねられたので、していると答えると、何故
かほっとしたようだった。
dialogues.en: "Ah, I will get it......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I will get it......"

dialogues.jp:
彼女の発した黄色いリボン、という単語に、俺
は今朝の夢を思い出した。
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's okay. I will."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's okay. I will."

dialogues.jp:
結局、頼子さんは居間で寝起きすることになっ
たのだった。
dialogues.en:
I stop her from standing up. Even though she's my maid now,
I can't have her at my beck and call.
dialogues.text:
I stop her from standing up. Even though she's my maid now,
I can't have her at my beck and call.
